title: Gideon and the Cipher
author: K. M. Nakamura
blurb: Theo Ishikawa, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
